item: The storage-events history test polls the journal through the replace-tolerant helper, so a Windows read that meets the writer's os.replace is "not yet", not an error
summary: Windows observation shard 4 (run 44734791675) failed with PermissionError Errno 13 at the test's own poll, which read the journal directly while the writer replaced it. Every other poll used _file_total; this one now does, and a source check fails any _wait_until predicate that reads a file directly (red before, naming line 247). The product reader already retries. Windows shard 1 of the same run was stopped by the 90-minute job cap at 98% with no hang and no failure: a slower runner on the heaviest Windows shard (70.6-90+ minutes against a predicted 45, from a Linux-measured cost table). Test only, no user-facing change.
